WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.name AS empresa, ct.*
  FROM company_tasks ct JOIN companies c ON c.id = ct.company_id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'por_empresa', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
     SELECT empresa,
       count(*) AS total,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pendente') AS pendente,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='em_andamento') AS andamento,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='concluida') AS concluida,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status<>'concluida' AND due_date < current_date) AS atrasada,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date IS NULL) AS sem_data,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_recurring AND parent_task_id IS NULL) AS recorrentes,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_task_id IS NOT NULL) AS filhas,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_festa,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lead_id IS NOT NULL) AS com_lead,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE assigned_to IS NOT NULL) AS com_responsavel,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS criadas_30d,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE completed_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS concluidas_30d,
       max(created_at)::date AS ultima_criada,
       max(updated_at)::date AS ultima_mexida,
       count(DISTINCT created_by) AS criadores
     FROM t GROUP BY empresa ORDER BY count(*) DESC) x),
  'recorrentes', (SELECT json_agg(r) FROM (
     SELECT empresa, title, recurrence_type, recurrence_interval, recurrence_days, due_date, recurrence_end_date, status, created_at::date AS criada,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM company_tasks f WHERE f.parent_task_id = t.id) AS filhas
     FROM t WHERE is_recurring AND parent_task_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30) r),
  'atrasadas_amostra', (SELECT json_agg(a) FROM (
     SELECT empresa, title, category, due_date, status, is_recurring, parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AS filha
     FROM t WHERE status<>'concluida' AND due_date < current_date ORDER BY due_date DESC LIMIT 25) a),
  'categorias', (SELECT json_agg(k) FROM (SELECT category, count(*) n FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC) k),
  'crons', (SELECT json_agg(j) FROM (SELECT jobname, schedule, active, left(command, 200) AS cmd FROM cron.job WHERE command ILIKE '%task%' OR jobname ILIKE '%task%' OR jobname ILIKE '%tarefa%') j),
  'cron_runs', (SELECT json_agg(rr) FROM (SELECT j.jobname, d.status, d.start_time::date AS dia, left(d.return_message, 120) AS msg FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.command ILIKE '%task%' ORDER BY d.start_time DESC LIMIT 6) rr),
  'assigned_to_tipo', (SELECT data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='company_tasks' AND column_name='assigned_to'),
  'fn_notify', (SELECT pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.proname='fn_notify_task_assigned' LIMIT 1),
  'triggers', (SELECT json_agg(tg.tgname) FROM pg_trigger tg WHERE tg.tgrelid = 'public.company_tasks'::regclass AND NOT tg.tgisinternal),
  'notificacoes', (SELECT json_agg(n) FROM (SELECT type, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE read) AS lidas, max(created_at)::date AS ultima FROM notifications WHERE type LIKE 'tarefa%' GROUP BY type) n),
  'template_uso', (SELECT json_build_object('modelos', (SELECT count(*) FROM event_task_templates), 'ativos', (SELECT count(*) FROM event_task_templates WHERE is_active)))
) AS r
